scope: At one physical depot, contrast FIFO and urgency-prioritized allocation of a repaired LRU between an earlier ordinary BASE-01 replenishment request and a later BASE-02 aircraft-blocking backorder; test Control.ENBOP and depot Station.BOPRI as a three-arm gate in one fixed SIMLOX 2017 source family.

manual.rule: Control.ENBOP=N ignores station backorder prioritisation. At the depot, Station.BOPRI=Y serves backorders by urgency at the supported station, prioritizing a station that itself has backorders over ordinary first-come-first-served replenishment. This test requires actual competing queued requests before an inbound item is allocated.

frozen_source_delta: Derive all arms from accepted E12.var02 two-fault individual-row control: seed1, one aircraft each at BASE-01 and BASE-02, shared DEPOT-01, 3.5-hour missions at h8/h20/h32, LRU failures at h9.8829/h11.1325 in the accepted parent, 36-hour horizon.

Set BASE-02 and DEPOT-01 opening TEACH-LRU-01 stock from 1 to 0; BASE-01 opening stock remains 1. Retain one-hour depot item repair and one-hour downward / three-hour upward item-specific transport. This is intended to queue an ordinary BASE-01 replenishment before a BASE-02 aircraft-blocking backorder, both before the first failed LRU is repaired.

FIFO arm has Control.ENBOP=Y and DEPOT-01 Station.BOPRI=N; priority arm has Y/Y; disabled arm has Control.ENBOP=N and depot BOPRI=Y. Only description, these two flag fields and the shared opening-stock changes differ from the accepted parent. Only description and the flags differ among arms.
acceptance_hypotheses: All three inputs import/export with exact populated-cell roundtrip, zero converter errors and usable SXO/event/report outputs. Warnings are classified.

Before the first inbound repaired item is allocated, raw events prove an earlier ordinary BASE-01 depot request and a later BASE-02 demand that waits for an aircraft-blocking spare; both requests remain outstanding concurrently.

At the first depot inbound item, FIFO sends the item to BASE-01 while priority sends it to BASE-02; disabled matches FIFO on the allocation and relevant downstream events. Every physical item has a single location or trip at a time; stock, outstanding demand and transport events reconcile.
Per-station stock/backorder report rows and mission outcomes reconcile with the event sequence; no conclusion is drawn from final success rate alone.
gate: Publish only the arm comparisons for which concurrent demand, distinct destination and Control/Station gate effects are directly established by sealed native events plus independent read-only replay. If the two requests do not coexist or priorities do not change allocation, retain immutable diagnostic and redesign a new version; no inference from manual or process exit alone.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, GUI PID 13340/session 1 identity, immutable run path, 60-second targeted child watchdog, source hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: One fixed seed, two bases, one depot, one item type and one inbound repaired item; no generalized priority tie-breaker, other demand mixes, lateral support, GUI or cross-engine claim.
